elder.speaker: Elder
pages: Long ago, the Sun Road joined the four cities: Brightwater, Ashford, Frostholm and Sunspire.
Then the Hollow King came. He sealed the road with four cursed dungeons, and no one who entered has ever come out the other side.
You're the first in a hundred years to try. Break the seals, Wayfarer, and set the road free.
The Sun Road is open again! Caravans already sing your name.
Three seals broken! Only the Hollow Spire remains, beyond Sunspire.
Two seals broken! Even the birds sound braver.
You broke the first seal! Ashford lies north, through the old gate.
Each dungeon is bigger than the last. Find the map, and the compass if you can.

healer.speaker: Healer
pages: Rest here and I'll restore your strength. I'll also record your journey.

kid.speaker: Kid
pages: Tip: press LB and RB to switch weapons and spells!
Hold A after swinging for a spin attack!
Whoa, a bow! Did you know stone eyes open gates when you shoot them?

villager1.speaker: Villager
pages: Press SELECT for your map. It fills in as you explore!
Rooms you've only peeked into show up as '?'. The dungeon map shows them all, and the compass shows the treasure.

innkeeper.speaker: Innkeeper
pages: Welcome to the inn, Wayfarer. A warm bed and a save, free of charge.

traveler.speaker: Traveler
pages: I tried to cross the Shadow Crypt. The dark there is alive...
...and I dropped my wedding ring somewhere inside! Could you find it for me?
My ring! I'll never lose it again. Thank you!
If you're poisoned, drink an Antidote, or rest here at the inn.
That's it! My ring! Please, take this reward.
My ring is somewhere in the Shadow Crypt. Some rooms only open from the far side...

town2_guard.speaker: Guard
pages: You came through the Catacombs?! Welcome to Ashford, Wayfarer.
The Shadow Crypt lies north. Bring fire magic, and light any torch you find.
The second seal is broken! I can finally sleep at night.

scholar.speaker: Scholar
pages: The Hollow King's dungeons are cunning. Every one hides a guardian, a lesser beast that keeps a treasure.
Beat the guardian and you'll find the tool that opens the rest of the dungeon.
And Shield Knights block attacks from the front. Hit them from the side!

town2_villager.speaker: Villager
pages: The blacksmith can upgrade your weapons. Even the strange ones you find in dungeons.
You look strong! Level 8 at least.

town2_kid.speaker: Kid
pages: Some doors are locked. Small keys open them, and the BIG key opens the boss door!
Sometimes all the doors slam shut... you have to beat every monster to get out!

farmer.speaker: Farmer
pages: Slimes! Slimes everywhere! They're eating my turnips.
Could you defeat 6 of them in the Mossy Catacombs? I'll pay you!
My turnips are safe. Thank you, hero!
You did it! Here, take this.
Still slimes out there... 6 is what I need.

town3_guard.speaker: Guard
pages: The Frost Cavern is north. Its guardian, the Yeti Chieftain, guards something that flies over chasms.
The Wyrm is gone and the snow is melting! Sunspire lies north.

explorer.speaker: Explorer
pages: I'm studying the Frost Herbs that grow in the cavern.
Could you bring me 3 of them? I'll pay well.
My research is going wonderfully, thanks to you!
Three perfect Frost Herbs! Here's your reward.
Frost Herbs grow in hidden corners of the cavern. Some are across the water...

hunter.speaker: Hunter
pages: Yetis keep raiding our storehouse. Defeat 4 of them and I'll give you some of my bombs.
Not a yeti in sight. Good work!
Four yetis! Here, you earned these.
Yetis lurk in the Frost Cavern. Watch out for their snowballs.

town3_kid.speaker: Kid
pages: Bombs blow up cracked walls! The Crypt Knight dropped some for you? Lucky!
There's a cracked wall somewhere in town, too! Hee hee.

town4_greeter.speaker: Guard
pages: A traveler from the south?! The road's been sealed for a hundred years!
Welcome to Sunspire, city of the sun. Or... it was, before the Spire went hollow.
The sun is back over Sunspire! You did it!

sage.speaker: Sage
pages: So you are the one who broke the seals. I felt each of them crack.
The Hollow King waits atop the Spire to the north. His guardian, the Fire Drake, keeps the Flame Brand.
Only that holy fire can light the braziers that bar his throne. Go, Wayfarer. End it.
The King is gone, and the four cities are one road again. Thank you.

town4_merchant.speaker: Merchant
pages: Caravans haven't come in a century. My prices are... historical.

town4_kid.speaker: Kid
pages: Lava burns! Don't touch the orange stuff.
The fire imps hate cold. Try ice magic!

town4_lady.speaker: Weaver
pages: My grandmother told stories of Brightwater. Is it true the fountains there sing?
Now I can visit Brightwater myself!
